CicdExecutionPolicy.description:
Small authoring surface for strict CI/CD execution.

Repository admission belongs exclusively to ``requirements``. Resource values are
optional execution caps: omitted values inherit the selected executor's currently
available capacity and are recorded as runtime capacity evidence instead of being
replaced by hidden static defaults.
CicdExecutionPolicy.title: CicdExecutionPolicy

CicdResourcePolicy.description:
Optional author-imposed process-tree resource caps.

Omitted fields are deliberately *not* replaced by static product defaults. They
inherit the capacity available from the selected executor at execution time, so
an ordinary CI/CD plan can run on a laptop, workstation or large worker without
silently acquiring a 2 CPU / 2 GiB / 64 PID contract. Executor-capacity evidence
records the capacity observed for each admitted run; that capacity may change
between runs.
CicdResourcePolicy.title: CicdResourcePolicy
